patch_description: Replace the clipped concentric-ring construction with a constrained nonlinear optimization of all 26 center coordinates and radii simultaneously.  The seed is a staggered five-row, near-hexagonal arrangement with row populations 5,5,6,5,5, which is substantially better suited to a square than the former rings.  SLSQP then optimizes the linear objective (sum of radii) subject to exact wall-clearance and pairwise non-overlap constraints.  Two deterministic starts, including a small reproducible perturbation, help avoid an unnecessarily symmetric local optimum.  A final uniform radius repair makes the returned solution robust against optimizer tolerances while preserving all optimized relative radii.
